problem_statement: OSSPhilippines/freefolio is a 100% static portfolio-template gallery: a hand-authored index.html (styled with a locally compiled Tailwind stylesheet, a vendored Font Awesome icon set and a vendored AOS scroll library) that showcases fourteen free portfolio templates. The homepage shows the Freefolio header/nav, a hero, a 'Popular this week' spotlight strip, a 'Browse templates by style' FILTER panel above the template gallery grid, the grid itself, a call-to-action band and the community footer. The filter is the gallery's own control: a category tab row (All / Minimal / Creative / Professional / Dark) that filters the fourteen template cards by their data-category and shows a live count readout ('Showing N of 14 · <label>'); the same filter panel and a shared 'Browse by style' rail also appear on two secondary pages, starters.html and showcase.html, so the browsing controls are consistent wherever a visitor lands. Four regressions must be repaired together: (1) RESPONSIVE — on a 390px phone the filter tab row is a fixed-width no-wrap flex row that forces the whole page to scroll sideways; make it reflow within the viewport with no horizontal overflow. (2) CROSS-PAGE CONSISTENCY — the shared 'Browse by style' rail must be present on the home gallery AND on starters.html AND on showcase.html, not on the home page alone. (3) VISUAL — the gallery grid must lay the template cards out cleanly (no overlapping/clipped cards), the active category tab must be legible, and the browse rail must keep the ossph-blue/ivory palette (not a dark slab). (4) INTERACTION — clicking a category tab must actually filter the grid AND update the count readout to 'Showing N of 14 · <label>', not leave a frozen 'Showing all 14 templates'. The fix lives in the gallery-filter stylesheet and script and the shared markup; do not alter the hero, the header/nav, the spotlight strip content, the footer or any template subdirectory.
required_content: The 'Browse templates by style' filter panel renders the five category tabs (All, Minimal, Creative, Professional, Dark) and a live count readout above the fourteen-card template gallery grid at every viewport.
On a 390px mobile viewport the homepage no longer scrolls horizontally: the filter tab row reflows within the viewport (no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance).
The shared 'Browse by style' rail appears on the home gallery AND on the starters.html and showcase.html secondary pages, keeping the ossph-blue/ivory Freefolio palette.
The template gallery grid lays its cards out cleanly with no overlapping or clipped cards, and the selected category tab stays legible (readable label, clear active state).

Clicking a category tab filters the grid to the matching templates and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 14 · <label>' (e.g. 'Showing 7 of 14 · Minimal'); it never leaves a stale 'Showing all 14 templates'.
The hero, header/nav, 'Popular this week' spotlight strip, CTA band and footer remain intact and unchanged.
design_constraints: Preserve Freefolio's visual language: the ossph-blue palette, card rounding, soft shadows, light/dark theme and generous spacing across the filter panel, the browse rail and the grid.
Keep the filter a single labelled 'Browse templates by style' panel above the gallery grid; do not remove or reword the five category tabs or the count readout.
The shared 'Browse by style' rail must appear on the home gallery, starters.html and showcase.html (consistent browsing controls), not on the home page alone.

The filter tab row must remain a horizontal row on desktop/tablet where space allows but must reflow within the viewport on narrow (mobile) widths rather than forcing sideways scrolling; do not mask overflow with overflow-x:hidden on the document or the row.
The category filter must genuinely filter the grid and keep the count readout in sync with the selected category on every click.

desktop_spotlight scrolls the 1440px homepage to the 'Popular this week' spotlight strip to confirm the untouched section is preserved.
desktop_hero captures the 1440px hero to confirm the untouched hero is preserved.

change_completion: The 'Browse templates by style' filter panel renders the five category tabs and the count readout above the fourteen-card template gallery grid at every viewport.
Clicking a category tab filters the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 14 · <label>'; the shared 'Browse by style' rail is present on the home gallery and both secondary pages.
The hero, header/nav, spotlight strip, CTA band and footer remain intact and reachable.
design_consistency: The repair preserves Freefolio's ossph-blue palette, card rounding, soft shadows, light/dark theme and spacing across the filter panel, grid and browse rail.
The template grid lays out cleanly with no overlapping/clipped cards and the active category tab stays legible.
responsive: 390px mobile homepage has no horizontal overflow at the filter tab row or elsewhere.
834px tablet and 1440px desktop filter and grid layouts are preserved and continue to fit.
regression: The static homepage and secondary pages still serve and render with zero remote requests and zero console errors.
All non-filter sections (hero, spotlight strip, CTA, footer) are unchanged.

author_notes: True-new-L4 rebuild of the freefolio template-gallery task. The native lever is the gallery's own category FILTER (tab row + 'Showing N of 14 · <label>' count readout) above the fourteen-card #templatesGrid, plus a shared 'Browse by style' rail promoted onto the starters.html and showcase.html secondary pages. The graded diff is gallery-filter.css + gallery-filter.js + the shared filter/rail markup + starters.html + showcase.html; the hero, header/nav, spotlight strip and footer are untouched. Reference passes all four gates. Baseline reproduces a fixed-width no-wrap tab row (mobile overflow ~419px) with the rail absent everywhere, but its filter wiring is correct so it PASSES the interaction gate. The smart-wrong bad narrows the tab row + adds overflow-x:hidden (still ~259px overflow), shingles the grid cards with negative margins, renders the active tab dark-on-dark and the rail as a dark-teal slab, and freezes the count readout so a tab click never re-filters — failing all four gates while content/console/completion stay clean.
